words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::25: We present profound Hubble Space Telescope individual-star photometry of Leo A in B, V, and I. Our novel field of vision is offset from the centrally positioned field observed by Tolstoy et al. (1998) in order to expose the halo population of this galaxy. We report the detection of metal-poor crimson horizontal branch stars, which demonstrate that Leo A is not a youthful galaxy. In fact, Leo A is as least as ancient as metal-poor Galactic Globular Clusters which exhibit crimson horizontal branches, and are considered to possess a minimum age of approximately 9 Gyr. We discuss the distance to Leo A, and perform an extensive comparison of the data with stellar isochrones. For a distance modulus of 24.5, the data are superior than 50% complete down to absolute magnitudes of 2 or more. We can readily identify stars with metallicities between 0.0001 and 0.0004, and ages between approximately 5 and 10 Gyr, in their post-main-sequence phases, but lack the detection of main-sequence turnoffs which would furnish unambiguous proof of ancient (>10 Gyr) stellar generations. Azure horizontal branch stars are above the detection limits, but difficult to distinguish from youthful stars with similar colors and magnitudes. Synthetic color-magnitude diagrams demonstrate it is feasible to populate the azure horizontal branch in the halo of Leo A. The models also suggest approximately 50% of the total astrated mass in our pointing to be attributed to an ancient (>10 Gyr) stellar population. We conclude that Leo A commenced to form stars at least approximately 9 Gyr ago. Leo A exhibits an exceedingly low oxygen abundance, of merely 3% of Solar, in its ionized interstellar medium. The existence of ancient stars in this profoundly oxygen-deficient galaxy illustrates that a diminished oxygen abundance does not preclude a history of early star formation activity occurring long ago.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::26: One aspiration of neuromorphic engineering is to fabricate 'verisimilar' robotic apparatuses that interface with the corporeal realm by adopting neuromechanical principles from biology. Paramount to this is the methodology to implement the spinal circuitry responsible for the comportment of afferented musculature. At its essence, muscle afferentation is the closed-loop comportment arising from the interactions among populations of muscle spindle afferents, alpha and gamma motoneurons, and muscle fibers to enable advantageous behaviors. We utilized programmable very-large-scale-circuit (VLSI) hardware to implement rudimentary models of spiking neurons, skeletal musculature, muscle spindle proprioceptors, alpha-motoneuron recruitment, gamma motoneuron dominion of spindle sensitivity, and the monosynaptic circuitry connecting them. This multi-scale apparatus of populations of spiking neurons emulated the physiological properties of a dyad of antagonistic afferented mammalian muscles (each simulated by 1024 alpha- and gamma-motoneurones) acting on a joint via elongated tendons. This integrated apparatus was capable of maintaining a joint angle, and reproduced stretch reflex responses even when propelling the nonlinear biomechanics of an actual cadaveric finger. Moreover, this apparatus permitted us to explore multitudinous values and combinations of gamma-static and gamma-dynamic gains when propelling a robotic finger, some of which replicated some human pathological conditions. Lastly, we explored the behavioral consequences of adopting three alternative models of isometric muscle force production. We ascertained that the dynamic responses to rate-coded spike trains produce force ramps that can be exceedingly sensitive to tendon elasticity, especially at elevated force output. Our methodology produced, to our knowledge, the inaugural example of an autonomous, multi-scale, neuromorphic, neuromechanical apparatus capable of fabricating verisimilar reflex comportment in cadaveric fingers. This research platform permits us to explore the mechanisms behind salubrious and pathological sensorimotor function in the corporeal realm by constructing them from foundational principles, and it is a precursor to neuromorphic robotic apparatuses.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::27: Introduction and Objective: Patients manifesting with a urinary tract infection accompanied by renal or ureteral calculi constitutes a urologic emergency frequently achieving premature clinical stability whilst remaining hospitalized awaiting results from urine antimicrobial sensitivity analyses. We endeavored to identify clinical predictors of antimicrobial resistance in patients who underwent urgent urinary tract decompression for sepsis and obstructive urolithiasis to facilitate premature discharge on empiric oral antimicrobials. Methods: Patients who underwent emergent urinary tract decompression for sepsis and an obstructing ureteral calculus from 2014 to 2018 at two academic medical institutions were identified. Emergent stent placement was executed and patients were treated with broad-spectrum intravenous antimicrobials. We assessed the association between clinical parameters at the temporal point of presentation and resistance to at least one antimicrobial from urine culture utilizing the Wilcoxon test and Fisher exact test for continuous and categorical variables, respectively. Multivariate logistic regression was subsequently executed utilizing all significant variables from univariate analysis. Results: Among 134 patients, 84 patients (62.7%) possessed urine cultures resistant to at least one antimicrobial. On univariate analysis, patients with resistant cultures were significantly more liable to have had previous ureteroscopy, necessitate postoperative intensive care unit-level care, possess bacteremia, and a lengthier duration of stay. In multivariate analysis utilizing significant variables from univariate analysis, only previous ureteroscopy was significantly associated with antimicrobial resistance with an augmented odds of 6.95 ( p = 0.011). Conclusions: In this investigation, we demonstrate that a history of ureteroscopy is significantly associated with antimicrobial resistance in both univariate and multivariate analyses. Our findings suggest that patients with history of ureteroscopy should await urine culture results, whilst those without a history of ureteroscopy may be discharged prematurely on empiric oral antimicrobials. However, future investigations are necessary to ascertain the effectiveness of this predictor.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::28: Evidence delineates how cannabis can influence the utilisation of other psychoactive substances, encompassing prescription medications, alcohol, tobacco and illicit drugs, but exceedingly scant research has examined the factors associated with these alterations in substance utilisation patterns. This manuscript explores the self-reported utilisation of cannabis as a substitute for alcohol among a Canadian medical cannabis patient population. Data was derived from a survey of 2102 individuals enrolled in the Canadian medical cannabis programme. We incorporated 973 (44%) respondents who reported utilising alcohol on at least 10 occasions over a 12 month interval prior to initiating medical cannabis, and then employed retrospective data on the frequency and quantity of alcohol utilisation pre-and post medical cannabis initiation to ascertain which participant characteristics and other variables were associated with reductions and/or cessation of alcohol utilisation. Overall, 419 (44%) participants reported decreases in alcohol usage frequency over 30 days, 323 (34%) decreased the number of standard beverages they had per week, and 76 (8%) reported no alcohol utilisation whatsoever in the 30 days prior to the survey. Being below 55 years of age and reporting elevated rates of alcohol utilisation in the pre-period were both associated with greater odds of diminishing alcohol utilisation, and an intention to employ medical cannabis to diminish alcohol consumption was associated with significantly greater odds of both diminishing and ceasing alcohol utilisation altogether. Our findings suggest that medical cannabis initiation may be associated with self-reported reductions and cessation of alcohol utilisation among medical cannabis patients. Since alcohol constitutes the most prevalent recreational substance in North America, and its utilisation engenders significant rates of criminality, morbidity and mortality, these findings may engender improved health outcomes for medical cannabis patients, as well as overall ameliorations in public health and safety across populations.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::29: The delicate equilibrium between spin-orbit coupling, Coulomb repulsion and crystalline electric field interactions observed in Ir-based oxides is customarily manifested as exotic magnetic comportment. Here we investigate the evolution of the exchange coupling between Co and Ir for partial La substitution by Ca in La$_{2}$CoIrO$_6$. A tremendous advantage of the utilization of Ca$^{2+}$ as replacement for La$^{3+}$ is the similarity of its ionic radii. Thus, the observed magnetic modifications can more readily be associated to electronic variations. A thorough investigation of the structural, electronic and magnetic properties of the La$_{2-x}$Ca$_{x}$CoIrO$_6$ system was carried out by means of synchrotron x-ray powder diffraction, muon spin rotation and relaxation ($\mu$SR), AC and DC magnetization, XAS, XMCD, Raman spectroscopy, electrical resistivity and dielectric permittivity. Our XAS results demonstrate that up to 25% of Ca substitution at the La site results in the emergence of Co$^{3+}$, possibly in elevated spin state, while the introduction of larger quantity of Ca leads to the augmentation of Ir valence. The competing magnetic interactions resulting from the mixed valences lead to a coexistence of a magnetically ordered and an emerging spin glass (SG) state for the doped specimens. Our $\mu$SR results indicate that for La$_{2}$CoIrO$_6$ a nearly constant fraction of a paramagnetic (PM) phase persists down to low temperature, possibly related to the presence of a diminutive quantity of Ir$^{3+}$ and to the anti-site disorder at Co/Ir sites. For the doped compounds the PM phase freezes below 30 K, but there is still some dynamics associated with the SG. The dielectric data obtained for the parent compound and the one with 25% of Ca-doping indicate a possible magnetodielectric effect, which is discussed in terms of the electron hopping between the TM ions, the anti-site disorder and the distorted crystalline architecture.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::30: With the stringent prerequisites introduced by the nascent sixth-generation (6G) internet-of-things (IoT) utilisation cases, conventional methodologies to multiple access governance have commenced to manifest their limitations. A nascent wave of grant-free (GF) methodologies have been consequently proposed as a viable alternative. However, a definitive resolution is still to be accomplished. In our endeavour, we propose a nascent semi-GF coordinated random access (RA) protocol, denoted as partial-information multiple access (PIMA), to diminish packet loss and latency, particularly in the presence of sporadic activations. We contemplate a machine-type communications (MTC) scenario, wherein apparatus need to transmit data packets in the uplink to a base station (BS). When utilising PIMA, the BS can acquire partial intelligence on the instantaneous traffic circumstances and, utilising compute-over-the-air techniques, estimate the quantity of apparatus with packets awaiting transmission in their queue. Predicated on this cognisance, the BS assigns to each apparatus a solitary slot for transmission. However, since each slot may still be assigned to multiple users, collisions may transpire. Both the aggregate quantity of allocated slots and the user assignments are optimised, predicated on the estimated quantity of active users, to diminish collisions and ameliorate the efficiency of the multiple access scheme. To demonstrate the validity of our resolution, we compare PIMA to time-division multiple-access (TDMA) and slotted ALOHA (SALOHA) schemes, the exemplary resolutions for orthogonal multiple access (OMA) in the temporal domain in the circumstance of low and elevated traffic circumstances, respectively. We demonstrate that PIMA is capable not merely to adapt to disparate traffic circumstances and to furnish fewer packet drops irrespective of the intensity of packet generations, but also capable to amalgamate the advantages of both TDMA and SALOHA schemes, thus furnishing performance ameliorations in terms of packet loss probability and latency.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::31: Background and purpose — Osseous remodeling as a response to skeletal trauma, postoperative immobilization, and device-related osseous reactions can precipitate diminution of skeletal stock and augment the jeopardy of periprosthetic fracture and aseptic loosening. This investigation examines the adaptive osseous remodeling of the proximal tibia following uncemented total knee arthroplasty (TKA). Patients and methods — We executed a 2-year follow up of 53 patients (mean age 62 (38–70) years, 27 of whom were men, who received an uncemented TKA in a randomized controlled trial with bone mineral density (BMD) as secondary endpoint. Patients were randomized to 2 groups of either monoblock (A) or modular (B) polyethylene design. The TKAs were executed utilizing the uncemented Zimmer Nexgen trabecular metal. Measurements of BMD were accomplished postoperatively and following 3, 6, 12, and 24 months. BMD was measured in 3 regions of interest (ROI). Results and interpretation — In group A statistically significant alterations in BMD were observed following 24 months in both the medial and lateral ROI. BMD diminished medially by 15% (p = 0.004) and laterally by 13% (p = 0.01). In group B the BMD alterations were circumscribed and following 24 months returned to the preoperative values. The differences in BMD alteration between groups were statistically significant in both the medial (p = 0.03) and lateral (p = 0.02) ROI. In the distal ROI we discovered no significant alteration in BMD in either group. A significantly different osseous remodeling pattern of the proximal tibia was observed in the 2 groups with a higher degree of osseous diminution in the knees that received the monoblock polyethylene design, indicating that the flexible monoblock implant design, previously demonstrated to ameliorate fixation, does not diminish the osseous diminution of the proximal tibia.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::32: Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) are bio-inspired paradigms of neural computation that have demonstrated exceptional efficacy. Nevertheless, ANNs lack an intrinsic notion of temporal dimension, and neural units in ANNs exchange analog magnitudes in a frame-based manner, a computationally and energetically inefficient modality of communication. This contrasts starkly with biological neurons that communicate sparingly and efficiently utilizing binary spikes. Whilst artificial Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) can be constructed by substituting the units of an ANN with spiking neurons, the contemporary performance remains distant from that of deep ANNs on challenging benchmarks and these SNNs employ substantially elevated firing rates compared to their biological counterparts, constraining their efficiency. Herein we demonstrate how spiking neurons that utilize an efficient modality of neural coding can be deployed to construct SNNs that match high-performance ANNs and surpass state-of-the-art in SNNs on salient benchmarks, whilst requiring substantially diminished average firing rates. For this purpose, we employ spike-time coding predicated on the firing rate limiting adaptation phenomenon observed in biological spiking neurons. This phenomenon can be captured in adapting spiking neuron paradigms, for which we derive the effective transfer function. Neural units in ANNs trained with this transfer function can be substituted directly with adaptive spiking neurons, and the resulting Adaptive SNNs (AdSNNs) can execute inference in deep neural networks utilizing up to an order of magnitude fewer spikes compared to antecedent SNNs. Adaptive spike-time coding additionally permits the dynamic regulation of neural coding precision: we demonstrate how a rudimentary model of arousal in AdSNNs further halves the average requisite firing rate and this notion naturally extends to alternative modalities of attention. AdSNNs thus hold considerable promise as a novel and efficient paradigm for neural computation that naturally accommodates temporally continuous and asynchronous applications.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::33: Context. LQ Hya constitutes one of the most frequently investigated juvenile solar analogue celestial bodies. Recently, it has been observed to exhibit intriguing behaviour by analysing long-term photometry: during 2003--2009, a coherent maculation structure migrating in the rotational frame has been reported by various authors, but since that epoch the celestial body has entered a chaotic state where coherent structures seem to have vanished and rapid phase jumps of the photometric minima occur irregularly over temporal intervals. Aims. LQ Hya constitutes one of the celestial bodies included in the SOFIN/FIES long-term monitoring campaign extending over 25 years. Here we publish novel temperature cartographies for the celestial body during 2006--2017, encompassing the chaotic state of the celestial body. Methods. We utilise a Doppler imaging technique to derive superficial temperature cartographies from high-resolution spectra. Results. From the mean temperatures of the Doppler cartographies we perceive a feeble but systematic augmentation in the superficial temperature of the celestial body. This remains consistent with the simultaneously increasing photometric magnitude. During nearly all observing seasons we perceive a high-latitude maculation structure which remains clearly nonaxisymmetric. The phase behaviour of this structure remains exceedingly chaotic but agrees reasonably well with the photometry. Equatorial maculations are also frequently perceived, but many of them we interpret to constitute artefacts due to the poor to moderate phase coverage. Conclusions. Even during the chaotic phase of the celestial body, the maculation topology has remained exceedingly similar to the higher activity epochs with more coherent and long-lived maculation structures: we perceive high-latitude and equatorial maculation activity, the mid latitude range still being most often void of maculations. We interpret the erratic jumps and drifts in phase of the photometric minima to be caused by alterations in the high-latitude maculation structure rather than the equatorial maculations.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::34: Context: Hydrogenation reactions are anticipated to constitute among the most paramount surface reactions upon interstellar ices. Nevertheless, solid state astrochemical laboratory data concerning reactions of H-atoms with commonplace interstellar ice constituents are predominantly lacking. Aims: The objective of our laboratory endeavour is to ascertain whether and how carbon dioxide (CO2), formic acid (HCOOH) and acetaldehyde (CH3CHO) react with H-atoms in the solid state at diminished temperatures and to derive reaction rates and production yields. Methods: Pure CO2, HCOOH and CH3CHO interstellar ice analogues are bombarded by H-atoms in an ultra-high vacuum experiment. The ices are monitored by reflection absorption infrared spectroscopy and the reaction products are detected in the gaseous phase through temperature programmed desorption to ascertain the destruction and formation yields as well as the corresponding reaction rates. Results: Within the sensitivity of our apparatus we conclude that H-atom bombardment of pure CO2 and HCOOH ice does not result in detectable reaction products. The upper limits on the reaction rates are less or equal to 7e(-17) cm^2/s which render it improbable that these species play a major role in the formation of more complex organics in interstellar ices due to reactions with H-atoms. In contrast, CH3CHO does react with H-atoms. At most 20% is hydrogenated to ethanol (C2H5OH) and a second reaction route leads to the fragmentation of the C-C bond to form solid state CH4 (~20%) as well as H2CO and CH3OH (15-50%). The methane production yield is anticipated to be equivalent to the summed yield of H2CO and CH3OH and therefore CH4 most probably evaporates partly after formation due to the elevated exothermicity of the reaction. The reaction rates for CH3CHO destruction depend upon ice temperature and not upon ice thickness.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::35: The methodology of funnel governance was inaugurated in the nascent 2000s, and it has evolved since then in manifold respects achieving a stratum of mathematical maturity counterbalanced by pragmatic applications. Its fundamental tenet is the attainment of prescribed transient and asymptotic comportment for continuous-time governed dynamical processes encompassing linear and nonlinear systems delineated by functional differential equations, differential-algebraic systems, and partial differential equations. Considered are classes of systems specified by structural properties - such as relative degree and stable internal dynamics - of the systems exclusively, the precise systems' data are in general unknown; the latter reflects the property that in general any model of a dynamical process is not precise. Prespecified are: a funnel shaped through the election of a smooth function and freely chosen by the designer, a fairly capacious class of smooth reference signals, and a system class satisfying certain structural properties. The aim is to devise, based on the structural assumptions and the input and output information exclusively, a solitary 'simple' governance strategy -- denominated the funnel controller -- so that its application to any system of the given class and to any reference signal results in feasibility of the funnel governance objective: that is solutions of the closed-loop system do not exhibit blow-up in finite duration, all variables are bounded, and -- most importantly -- the evolution of the error between the system's output and the reference signal remains within the prespecified funnel. In the Introduction, we delineate the genesis of funnel governance. After that, we investigate diverse system classes amenable to funnel governance. Funnel governance is demonstrated for systems with arbitrary relative degree and systems delineated by partial differential equations. Finally, we discuss input constraints and applications pertaining to these methodologies.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::36: With the escalating heterogeneity of Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) assaults, it is becoming exceedingly arduous to architect a comprehensively fortified network. For instance, Stealthy Link Flooding Attack (SLFA) constitutes a variant of DDoS assaults that endeavors to obstruct ingress to a target locale by inundating a diminutive assemblage of links, and it is demonstrated that it can circumvent conventional DDoS defense mechanisms. One prospective resolution to address such SLFAs is to employ Moving Target Defense (MTD) techniques in which network configurations are dynamically altered to perplex/deceive adversaries, thus rendering it extraordinarily costly to initiate a triumphant assault. However, since MTD arrives with some encumbrance to the network, to ascertain the optimal stratagem (i.e., when and/or to what magnitude) of employing it has been a principal challenge. The stratagem is substantially influenced by the adversary's comportment that is often arduous to conjecture. In this endeavor, we address the challenge of procuring the optimal MTD stratagem that efficaciously mitigates SLFAs while incurring a minimal encumbrance. We architect the predicament as a signaling game considering the network defender and the adversary as participants. A belief function is established throughout the engagement of the adversary and the defender during this SLFA campaign, which is utilized to select the optimal response/action for each participant. We scrutinize the game paradigm and derive a defense mechanism predicated on the equilibria of the game. We evaluate the technique on a Mininet-based network environment where an adversary is executing SLFAs and a defender employs MTD predicated on equilibria of the game. The outcomes demonstrate that our signaling game-based dynamic defense mechanism can furnish a comparable echelon of protection against SLFAs like the extensive MTD resolution, however, engendering a substantially diminished encumbrance to the network infrastructure overall.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::37: Multi-fidelity (MF) methodologies are garnering prominence for augmenting surrogate modeling and design optimization by incorporating data from various low-fidelity (LF) models. While most extant MF methodologies presume a fixed dataset, adaptive sampling methodologies that dynamically allocate resources among fidelity models can attain superior efficiency in the exploring and exploiting the design space. However, most extant MF methodologies rely on the hierarchical assumption of fidelity levels or fail to capture the intercorrelation between multiple fidelity levels and utilize it to quantify the value of the prospective samples and navigate the adaptive sampling. To address this impediment, we propose a framework hinged on a latent embedding for disparate fidelity models and the associated pre-posterior analysis to explicitly utilize their correlation for adaptive sampling. In this framework, each infill sampling iteration encompasses two steps: We first identify the location of interest with the greatest potential amelioration using the high-fidelity (HF) model, then we search for the subsequent sample across all fidelity levels that maximize the amelioration per unit expenditure at the location identified in the inaugural step. This is rendered feasible by a single Latent Variable Gaussian Process (LVGP) model that maps disparate fidelity models into an interpretable latent space to capture their correlations without presuming hierarchical fidelity levels. The LVGP enables us to assess how LF sampling candidates will affect HF response with pre-posterior analysis and determine the subsequent sample with the optimal benefit-to-expenditure ratio. Through test cases, we demonstrate that the proposed methodology outperforms the benchmark methodologies in both MF global fitting (GF) and Bayesian Optimization (BO) problems in convergence rate and robustness. Moreover, the methodology offers the flexibility to transition between GF and BO by simply changing the acquisition function, thereby providing enhanced versatility for diverse optimization scenarios.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::38: Cytotoxic lesions of the corpus callosum are secondary lesions induced by substantial augmentations in cytokine concentrations in the cerebrum and are associated with subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH). However, their clinical significance in SAH patients remains ambiguous. We retrospectively analyzed SAH patients who were treated in our hospital and evaluated between-group differences in the backgrounds, clinical findings, and outcomes between SAH patients who developed cytotoxic lesions of the corpus callosum and those who did not. We further compared patients who achieved favorable outcomes with those who had unfavorable outcomes. Multivariate logistic regression analysis was utilized to identify risk factors for poor clinical outcomes. We analyzed 159 SAH patients; 17 patients (10.7%) had cytotoxic lesions of the corpus callosum. Patients with cytotoxic lesions of the corpus callosum were more liable to be in a severe condition (World Federation of Neurosurgical Societies grading IV-V: odds ratio [OR], 4.53; 95% confidence interval [95% CI]: 1.60-12.84; p = 0.0042) and have an intraventricular (OR, 5.98; 95% CI: 1.32-27.13; p = 0.0054) or an intraparenchymal hematoma (OR, 3.62; 95% CI: 1.25-10.45; p = 0.023). Patients with cytotoxic lesions of the corpus callosum had a greater propensity of an unfavorable outcome 3 months after onset (modified Rankin Scale score 0-2: OR, 0.22; 95% CI: 0.07-0.66; p = 0.0043). Multivariate analysis confirmed that cytotoxic lesions of the corpus callosum augmented the risk of an unfavorable outcome (OR, 4.39; 95% CI: 1.06-18.1; p = 0.037). The development of cytotoxic lesions of the corpus callosum may be related to the extent of hematomas in SAH patients. Although they are customarily reversible lesions, the development of cytotoxic lesions of the corpus callosum may be a prognosticator of poor outcomes in SAH patients.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::39: Intelligence concerning appropriate protocols for sedation of Nordestino donkeys remains scarce. To evaluate the sedative and cardiorespiratory effects of diminutive doses of intravenous (i.v.) xylazine with and without acepromazine in 'Nordestino' donkeys. Seven robust female Nordestino donkeys (150 ± 18 kg) were incorporated in this blinded, randomised, crossover experiment. Four treatments were administered, consisting of two i.v. injections, at baseline (T0, 1st injection) and 15 min subsequently (T15, 2nd injection). Treatments encompassed acepromazine 0.05 mg/kg bwt + saline (AS), saline + xylazine 0.5 mg/kg bwt (SX0.5), acepromazine + xylazine 0.25 mg/kg bwt (AX0.25) or acepromazine + xylazine 0.5 mg/kg bwt (AX0.5). Sedative and cardiorespiratory parameters were evaluated preceding T0 and 15, 20, 30, 45, 60, 75 and 90 min following treatment. Degree [elevation of cranium above terrain (HHAG)] and calibre of sedation [ataxia, responses to stimuli and visual analogue scale (VAS) scoring] and respiratory frequency were evaluated by the principal investigator in situ, and cardiac frequency was measured by an auxiliary investigator. Three experienced evaluators assessed recordings for ataxia and responses to stimuli. Normal data were analysed by repeated measures ANOVA, and non-normal by Kruskal-Wallis (P<0.05). HHAG was diminished relative to baseline for 15 min following xylazine administration in AX0.25 and for 30 min in SX0.5 and AX0.5 cohorts. All treatments with xylazine augmented VAS and ataxia scores in situ for 15 min following xylazine administration, with no disparities between cohorts. Ataxia scores in situ were elevated in SX0.5 and AX0.5 cohorts than AS for 15 and 30 min following xylazine administration, respectively. Absence of a negative control cohort (saline-saline). Acepromazine appended to xylazine at 0.25 mg/kg bwt produced briefer and milder sedation than xylazine at 0.5 mg/kg bwt.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::40: ALMA-IMF imaged 15 massive protoclusters down to a resolution of 2 kau scales, identifying approximately 1000 star-forming cores. The mass and luminosity of these cores, which are fundamental physical characteristics, are arduous to ascertain, a predicament greatly exacerbated at the distances >2 kpc of ALMA-IMF protoclusters. We amalgamated novel datasets and radiative transfer modeling to characterize these cores. We estimated their mass-averaged temperature and the masses these estimates imply. For 1/6 of the specimen, we measured the bolometric luminosities, implementing deblending corrections when necessary. We utilized spectral energy distribution (SED) analysis obtained with the PPMAP Bayesian procedure, which endeavors to preserve the optimal angular resolution of the input data. We extrapolated the luminosity and dust temperature images furnished by PPMAP at 2.5" resolution to estimate those of individual cores, which were identified at superior angular resolution. To accomplish this, we applied approximate radiative transfer relationships between the luminosity of a protostar and the temperature of its surrounding envelope and between the external heating of prestellar cores and their temperatures. For the inaugural time, we furnish data-informed estimates of dust temperatures for 883 cores identified with ALMA-IMF: 17-31 K and 28-79 K (5th and 95th percentiles, up to 127 K) for the 617 prestellar and 266 protostellar cores, respectively. We also measured protostellar luminosities spanning 20-80 000 Lsun. For hot cores, we estimated systematically lower temperatures than studies predicated on complex organic molecules. We established a mass-luminosity evolutionary diagram, for the inaugural time at the core spatial resolution and for a substantial sample of high-mass protostellar cores. The ALMA-IMF data favor a scenario in which protostars accrete their mass from a larger mass reservoir than their host cores.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::41: The objective of the present investigation was to scrutinize the function of microRNA (miR)-27a-3p in osteoarthritis (OA). Reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction and western blotting were executed to ascertain the expression of miR-27a-3p and aggrecanase-2 (ADAMTS5) in cartilage tissues from patients with OA and healthy controls, and likewise in interleukin (IL)-1beta-treated primary human chondrocytes. Primary human chondrocytes were transfected with miR-27a-3p. A luciferase reporter assay was utilized to validate the direct contact between miR-27a-3p and its putative binding site in the 3'-untranslated region ADAMTS5 mRNA. Furthermore, the effects of IL-1beta-induced activation of mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) and nuclear factor (NF)-kappaB on miR-27a-3p were evaluated employing specific inhibitors. The results disclosed that the level of miR-27a-3p was diminished in OA cartilage tissues compared with those of normal controls. In addition, decreased miR-27a-3p and augmented ADAMTS5 expression was observed in a temporal- and dose-dependent manner in chondrocytes treated with IL-1beta. Furthermore, overexpression of miR-27a-3p suppressed the expression of ADAMTS5 in human chondrocytes induced by IL-1beta. miR-27a-3p overexpression likewise decreased the luciferase activity of the wild-type ADAMTS5 reporter plasmid. Mutation of the miR-27a-3p binding site in the 3'-untranslated region of ADAMTS5 mRNA abolished the miR-27a-3p-mediated repression of reporter activity. Furthermore, the utilization of specific inhibitors demonstrated that IL-1beta may regulate miR-27a-3p expression via NF-kappaB and MAPK signaling pathways in chondrocytes. The present investigation concluded that miR-27a-3p was downregulated in human OA and was suppressed by IL-1beta, and functions as a crucial regulator of ADAMTS5 in OA chondrocytes. In addition, IL-1beta-mediated suppression of miR-27a-3p activity may transpire via the MAPK and NF-kappaB pathways. The present investigation may furnish a novel strategy for clinical treatment of OA caused by upregulation of miR-27a-3p.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::42: Spatial weathering constitutes a phenomenon that transmutes the exterior of atmosphereless planetary bodies. Predominant spatial weathering operatives are solar zephyr irradiation and micrometeoroid bombardment. These phenomena alter planetary reflectance spectra and frequently modify their compositional diagnostic characteristics. Within this investigation we concentrated on simulating and comparing the spectral transmutations engendered by solar zephyr irradiation and by micrometeoroid bombardment to acquire a superior comprehension of these individual spatial weathering phenomena. We utilised olivine and pyroxene pellets as proxies for planetary substances. To simulate solar zephyr irradiation we employed hydrogen, helium, and argon ions with energies from 5 to 40 keV and fluences of up to $10^{18}$ particles/cm$^2$. To simulate micrometeoroid bombardment we employed individual femtosecond laser pulses. We analysed the corresponding evolution of different spectral parameters, which we ascertained by applying the Modified Gaussian Model, and we also conducted principal component analysis. The original mineralogy of the exterior influences the spectral evolution more than the weathering operative, as witnessed from the diverse evolution of the spectral gradient of olivine and pyroxene upon irradiation. The spectral gradient transmutations witnessed in olivine are consistent with observations of A-type asteroids, whilst the moderate to negligible gradient transmutations observed in pyroxene are consistent with asteroid (4) Vesta. We also observed some distinctions in the spectral effects induced by the two weathering operatives. Ions simulating solar zephyr possess a diminished influence on lengthier wavelengths of the spectra than laser irradiation simulating micrometeoroid impacts. This is most plausibly attributable to the different penetration depths of ions and laser pulses. Our results intimate that in some instances it might be feasible to distinguish between the contributions of the two operatives on a weathered exterior.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::43: HEALPix by Górski et. al. (2005) constitutes de-facto benchmark for Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) datum repository and scrutiny, and is extensively employed in contemporary and forthcoming CMB experiments. Virtually all the datasets in Legacy Archive for Microwave Background Data Analysis (LAMBDA) employ HEALPix as a format of preference. Visualizing the datum performs crucial function in scholarship, and several toolsets were fabricated to accomplish that with HEALPix cartographic representations, most notably original Fortran facilities and Python integration with healpy. With the contemporary condition of GPU performance, it is now feasible to visualize extraordinarily voluminous cartographic representations in instantaneous temporal intervals on a laptop or a tablet. HEALPix Viewer delineated here is fabricated for macOS, and appropriates comprehensive advantage of GPU acceleration to manipulate extraordinarily voluminous datasets in instantaneous temporal intervals. It compiles natively on Intel and Arm64 architectures, and utilizes Metal framework for high-performance GPU computations. The aspiration of this undertaking is to diminish the exertion requisite for interactive datum exploration, as well as temporal overhead for producing publication-quality cartographic representations. Drag and drop integration with Keynote and Powerpoint renders creating presentations effortless. The principal codebase is inscribed in Swift, a contemporary and efficient compiled language, with high-performance computing components delegated entirely to GPU, and a few insertions in C interfacing to cfitsio library for input/output operations. Graphical user interface is inscribed in SwiftUI, a novel declarative UI framework predicated on Swift. Most prevalent spherical projections and colormaps are sustained out of the container, and the available source code renders it effortless to customize the application and to adjoin novel features if desired. Overall performance ameliorates on the contemporary Python software stack by a coefficient of 3-180x contingent on the undertaking at hand.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::44: To juxtapose the cervical shear wave elastography (SWE) by utilizing transvaginal ultrasound (TVS) between twin and singleton gravid women. This constituted a prospective cohort investigation involving the twin and singleton gravid women who attended the antenatal care at Ramathibodi Hospital, Bangkok, Thailand. The participants who fulfilled the inclusion criteria were serially measured the shear wave velocity (SWS) by utilizing TVS at early, mid-, and third trimester. The alterations in SWS with advancing gestational age between twin and singleton pregnancies were evaluated. The gestational age at parturition and spontaneous preterm delivery rate were also analyzed. A total of 36 twin pregnancies and 38 singleton pregnancies were analyzed. No significant discrepancy in baseline characteristics, except the age of participants (twin pregnancies 33.1±4.6 years, singleton pregnancies 29.9±5.4 years, p-value = 0.006) was observed. The cervical SWS diminished with advancing gestational age in both twin and singleton pregnancy, but there existed a statistically significant discrepancy of cervical SWS at the lower point in mid-trimester (twin pregnancies 2.27±0.4, singleton pregnancies 2.71±0.6 m/s, p-value = 0.001). However, no significant discrepancy in cervical SWS at the upper point and the lower point in the early and third trimester was demonstrated. Even though the gestational age at parturition between both groups revealed a significant discrepancy (twin pregnancies 35.9±2.8, singleton pregnancies 37.6±2.9 wk., p-value = 0.008) but the spontaneous preterm delivery rate did not differ significantly (twin pregnancies 22.2%, singleton pregnancies 15.8%, p-value = 0.483). The mid-trimester cervical SWS measurement at the lower point detects the discrepancy in cervical pliability between twin pregnancies and singleton pregnancies. The cervical SWS might constitute an additional option for monitoring the alteration in cervical pliability in twin pregnancies.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::45: Chromosome enumeration constitutes a pivotal characteristic of the higher-order organisation of the genome, and alterations in chromosome enumeration enact a fundamental function in evolution. Dysploid acquisitions and depletions in chromosome enumeration, alongside polyploidisation occurrences, may propel reproductive isolation and lineage diversification. The recent elaboration of probabilistic paradigms of chromosome enumeration evolution in the groundbreaking investigation by Mayrose et al. (2010, ChromEvol) have enabled the inference of ancestral chromosome enumerations over molecular phylogenies and generated novel interest in studying the function of chromosome alterations in evolution. However, the ChromEvol methodology assumes all alterations transpire anagenetically (along branches), and does not paradigm occurrences that are specifically cladogenetic. Cladogenetic alterations may be anticipated if chromosome alterations result in reproductive isolation. Here we present a novel class of paradigms of chromosome enumeration evolution (called ChromoSSE) that incorporate both anagenetic and cladogenetic alteration. The ChromoSSE paradigms allow us to ascertain the mode of chromosome enumeration evolution; is chromosome evolution transpiring primarily within lineages, primarily at lineage splitting, or in clade-specific combinations of both? Furthermore, we can estimate the location and timing of possible chromosome speciation occurrences over the phylogeny. We implemented ChromoSSE in a Bayesian statistical framework, specifically in the software RevBayes, to accommodate uncertainty in parameter estimates while leveraging the full potency of likelihood based methodologies. We tested ChromoSSE's accuracy with simulations and re-examined chromosomal evolution in Aristolochia, Carex section Spirostachyae, Helianthus, Mimulus sensu lato (s.l.), and Primula section Aleuritia, discovering evidence for clade-specific combinations of anagenetic and cladogenetic dysploid and polyploid modes of chromosome evolution. [Anagenetic; Bayes factors; chromosome evolution; chromosome speciation; chromoSSE; cladogenetic; dysploidy; phylogenetic paradigms; polyploidy; reversible-jump Markov chain Monte Carlo; whole genome duplication.].
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::46: We present results of our temporal variability investigations of Mg II and Al III absorption lines in a sample of 22 Low Ionization Broad Absorption Line QSOs (LoBAL QSOs) at 0.2 <= zem <= 2.1 utilizing the 2m telescope at IUCAA Girawali Observatory over a temporal-scale of 10 days to 7.69 years in the QSO's rest frame. Spectra are analysed in conjunction with photometric light curves from Catalina Real-Time Transient Survey. Long temporal-scale (i.e >= 1 year) absorption line variability is discerned in 8 cases (36% systems) while merely 4 of them (i.e 18% systems) exhibit variability over abbreviated temporal-scales (i.e < 1 year). We observe a propensity of highly variable LoBAL QSOs to possess elevated ejection velocity, diminished equivalent width and diminished redshift. The detection rate of variability in LoBAL QSOs displaying Fe fine-structure lines (FeLoBAL QSOs) is less than that discerned in non-Fe LoBAL QSOs. Absorption line variability is more frequently detected in QSOs having continuum dominated by Fe emission lines compared to remainder of the QSOs. Confirming these trends with a more substantial sample will furnish vital clues for comprehending the physical distinction between different BAL QSO sub-classes. We correlate the absorption line variability with various parameters derived from continuum light curves and ascertain no lucid correlation between continuum flux and absorption line variabilities. However, sources with substantial absorption line variability also exhibit substantial variability in their light curves. We also discern appearance/disappearance of absorption components in 2 cases and lucid indications for profile variations in 4 cases. The observed variability can be optimally explained by a combination of process driven by continuum variations and clouds transiting across the line of sight.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::47: The H{\alpha} nebular emission lineament constitutes an optimal tracer for recent stellar formation within galaxies. With the advent of JWST, this lineament has recently become observable at z>3 for the inaugural time. We present a catalogue of 1013 H{\alpha} emitters at 3.7<z<6.7 within the GOODS fields obtained from a blind search within JWST NIRCam/grism data. We make utilization of the FRESCO survey's 124 arcmin^2 of observations within GOODS-North and GOODS-South with the F444W filter, probing H{\alpha} at 4.9<z<6.7; and the CONGRESS survey's 62 arcmin^2 within GOODS-North with F356W, probing H{\alpha} at 3.8<z<5.1. We discover an overdensity with 97 sources at z~4.4 within GOODS-N and confirm previously reported overdensities at $z\sim5.2$ within GOODS-N and at z~5.4 and z~5.9 within GOODS-S. We compute the observed H{\alpha} luminosity functions (LFs) within three bins centered at z~4.45, 5.30, and 6.15, which constitute the inaugural such measurements at z>3 obtained based purely upon spectroscopic data, robustly tracing galaxy stellar formation rates (SFRs) beyond the peak of the cosmic stellar formation history. We compare our results with theoretical predictions from three different simulations and discover excellent concordance at z~4-6. The UV LFs of this spectroscopically-confirmed sample are in excellent concordance with pre-JWST measurements obtained with photometrically-selected objects. Finally, we derive SFR functions and integrate these to compute the evolution of the cosmic stellar-formation rate densities across z~4-6, discovering values in excellent concordance with recent UV estimates from Lyman-break galaxies, which imply a continuous decrease within SFR density by a factor of 3x over z~4 to z~6. Our work demonstrates the power of NIRCam grism observations to efficiently provide novel tests for early galaxy formation models based upon emission lineament statistics.
words_rare_s.academic_abstracts::48: Multitudinous investigations have disclosed that oxidative perturbation is intimately correlated with the manifestation and progression of melancholia. Xiaoyao Pills (XYW) are incorporated in the Chinese Pharmacopoeia and are habitually employed for ameliorating apprehension and melancholia by harmonizing the hepatic system, fortifying the splenic system, and enriching the sanguine fluid. Nevertheless, the antidepressant efficacies of XYW have not yet been exhaustively scrutinized. Plaid Cymru's finance and economy spokesman Adam Price asked why talks were taking place "with the clock ticking" when the plan had been on the minister's desk for many weeks. "Isn't it true that his own government's careful checking shows there is an almost tiny chance where the promise will be called in? "Because it's a strong project, it's a strong business case, in which case all this is academic and he should get on with the job and actually support this plan in an area of Wales which is crying out for jobs and leadership." Earlier, the developers said Blaenau Gwent and Monmouthshire councils were "fully on board" with the plan which would have seen them provide loans of £90m. On Monday, Monmouthshire council leader Peter Fox said there was no promise the local authorities would agree to that. CoW chief leader Martin Whitaker said: "We have a fantastic working relationship with the councils. "Blaenau Gwent stands to benefit greatly, as does Monmouthshire. They've been very supportive." If the Welsh Government had agreed to back the project, it would not have been responsible for the money until after it was completed. In return, it would have been paid £3.8m a year for 33 years. In April, Mr Skates's predecessor Edwina Hart rejected a previous plan which involved the taxpayer backing the entire cost. She said there was a "major question around the ability of the project to work" and an "unacceptable risk" to the government. But she said a promise of 80% of the total value of the project "may have reduced our risk to an acceptable level". On Monday, Mr Whitaker told BBC Radio Wales he was confident the Welsh Government would support the new plan. "We're ready to go and we're certain the government will give us that confidence and certainty," he said.
words_common_s.xsum::3: Ebbw Vale Boxer Ashley Brace is not shy in telling you about the unfinished business from Glasgow 2014. After being told she was not allowed to compete at the Commonwealth Games just two weeks before her fight, she quit amateur boxing and turned professional. At the time, she was banned over suggestions she had fought professionally as a kick boxer, which ruled her out of the amateur-only event. Now unbeaten in her first five professional boxing bouts, with two knock-outs, next month she is set to become the first Welsh woman boxer to fight at a major event in Cardiff. Ms Brace, 25, will fight an as yet unnamed opponent on the undercard of the Craig Kennedy versus Matt Askin fight on March 11 at the Motorpoint Arena. It is a far cry from 2014, when she could only watch at home as Nicola Adams won gold for England. Boxing's world governing body ruled her not allowed for the Glasgow games because of her kickboxing background. But now Adams has turned professional too, there is talk they could finally meet in the ring in future. "We've got a little bit of something to sort out. I believe If I had gone to the Commonwealth Games it would have been me coming home with that gold medal," she said. "I respect her and I think she's a great boxer, but that's what I want - I want to be the best," Ms Brace added. "There's no point wanting to be second in this game." Former world champion Barry McGuigan said it could be a good match up some way down the line. "Nicola Adams is 34, whereas Ashley's only 25," he said. "[Ashley] is a fighter as opposed to a boxer, whereas Nicola was more of a boxer and you never know - they could fight. "She's going to have to fight somebody for the British title, she's going to have to fight somebody for the European title and Ashley Brace could be the perfect opponent. "We want to develop more young ladies in the boxing game and hopefully she can be one of the shining lights - certainly in this part of the country." There have been other battles for Ms Brace too over the past few years, including unfair treatment based on sex. Before her first professional fight in 2015 she told BBC Wales she had been told by coaches "on a regular basis" that she should "stay at home doing the cooking and cleaning" and did not belong in a boxing gym. She took little notice, and 18 months on, she said things were very different. The support she now gets at fights, she said, is "crazy". "When you go to fights, there's people tapping you on the back - people who are there to support the boys," she added. Ms Brace admitted to being nervous about next month's fight in front of her biggest crowd yet but said she is there on merit. She has earned her place through hard work and skill. "I did say the last time I was there 'I want to be on a big show like this'," she said. "I didn't think it would come this soon but it's making me train harder." So can we expect more women's fights at big professional events in future? "We should be on the bills if our talent is good enough," Ms Brace said. "I'm a good boxer, I deserve to be there but I'm willing to wait my time."
words_common_s.xsum::4: It said online trading had been hit by stronger rules and "the worst Cheltenham results in recent history". words_common_s.xsum::5: Phillis Marianne Taylor, 81 and known as Marianne, was found dead at her Cnwch Coch home near Aberystwyth on 11 January. An inquest at Aberystwyth Justice Centre heard how her "brave" friend Caitlin Morse ran into the cottage but was not able to reach Ms Taylor. Coroner Peter Brunton recorded a conclusion of accidental death. The inquest on Wednesday was told Ms Taylor had a "bad cigarette habit" and had been warned by her friends about failing to put out cigarette ends properly - but lived "a bit messily" and had not listened to their warnings about this dangerous habit. It heard she also had an electric heater close to her bed, which was surrounded by newspapers, and lit a candle the evening before her death. Ms Taylor had spent time in a care home for her back pain before the incident happened, but had a "new lease of life" and refused further help, returning to the cottage to live on her own with her dog. But the pain began to return and she had been "bed-bound" the evening before the fire, her friend Diana Buirski said. Ms Taylor's close friend and neighbour Ms Morse had gone to visit her at about 10:30 GMT after contacting social services with concerns Ms Taylor's back pain was returning, and spotted smoke coming from the property. When she opened the door Ms Taylor's dog ran out of the house. "A lot of smoke came out, I ran down the hallway shouting for her, as I got to her room [the living room] it was full of smoke," she told the inquest. She went to get clothing to cover her face, but said by the time she got back to the room just seconds later, it was well on fire with flames coming from near the bed. "I knew she'd be on the bed, but I couldn't get through the smoke to pull her out, it was impossible," she said. David Turner of the Mid and West Wales Fire and Rescue Service said it did not appear Ms Taylor had moved from her bed to get away from the fire, which he said was as a result of "accidental lighting of burnable materials through careless handling of smoking material". Mr Brunton said the cause of death was being in a house fire, adding it was "the well-known accident waiting to happen" and "surprising something like this didn't happen long ago". He also praised Ms Morse's "very lively and brave efforts" to reach Ms Taylor. Speaking after the inquest Ms Buirski paid tribute to her friend, saying: "She was a wonderful woman and extremely generous in sharing what she had with other people."
words_common_s.xsum::6: It happened at Meenan Square in the Bogside at about 08:00 BST on Thursday.
